rationale: The literal entry "200 ml de leite UHT" identifies the generic milk family and explicit 200 ml amount, with no commercial brand or fat-content variant. Canonical ADR §16 describes UHT as an informational descriptor for the milk family and prohibits inventing a new nutritional variant/clarification solely from this descriptor. Issue #1088 separately confines the restriction on generic nutritional fallback to commercial identity while allowing transparent generic estimates for genuinely unbranded foods. Review covers only semantic identity/quantity/action/provenance policy; it does not independently verify a specific processing-level nutrition classification or caloric values, nor claim production accuracy.
